discussion.body: Maera Sol. Main-side. Added so main-side count is eight. Temple of Light acolyte, Tierso isthmus. Joins Act 6 at the beacon. Design: pale travel whites that get dirty, FF8 proportion. Death crisis: beacon collapse if no one stays on the lamp. Default lives. Contingency: Meridian Sigil taken from the lamp itself. If dead, Light still functions as an aspect; the party has no living south guide. Not a rival romance. The only romance flag in the game is Cael/Liraen.
